mentions.name: Flippd
mentions.description: The successor to Pindigo, a social score-tracking and ranking app for pinball players, recently soft-launched. Includes a tech demo that uses custom computer-vision models to identify a pinball machine from a photo and extract the player's score.
mentions.source_excerpt: Most of my time lately has gone into Flippd, its successor, which we recently soft-launched. We’ve also released a tech demo that uses custom computer-vision models to identify a pinball machine from a photo and extract the player’s score.
mentions.author: needz
